text:
By 1931 the **Ashkenazi Jews** – the group that now makes up the majority of Jews worldwide – accounted for **about 92 % of the global Jewish population**.  

> *“Although in the 11th century they comprised only three percent of the world’s Jewish population, Ashkenazi Jews accounted for 92 percent of the world’s Jews in 1931, and today make up approximately 80 percent of Jews worldwide.”* – *New World Encyclopedia: “Ashkenazi”*  

This figure reflects the demographic weight that Ashkenazim carried in the early 20th‑century and underscores their continued dominance in contemporary Jewish demographics.
